info.name: g1n DarkVist - A dark theme for Checkvist.
info.description:
g1n DarkVist v1p01 – A dark theme for Checkvist.
The goal is low-glare, high-contrast reading and navigating: a calm warm-grey surface, dimmed base text, brighter emphasis, and a single muted orange accent that gently highlights selection, links and tags.

Version: v1p01
Date: 2026-09-20
Author: g1n – Bence Morgos
